vectors.name: Presentation XML Dimensions & ID Lists
vectors.description: Validates parsing of slide size (12192000 x 6858000 EMUs), notes size, master ID list, and slide ID list.
vectors.input: Presentation XML with widescreen slide size and 2 slide references.

vectors.name: Slide Master Components
vectors.description: Validates slide master cSld, spTree, color map, slideLayoutIdLst, and txStyles.
vectors.input: SlideMaster XML with color map and titleStyle lvl1pPr 44pt bold.

vectors.name: Slide Layout Components
vectors.description: Validates slide layout type, matchingName, preserve flag, shapes, and masterClrMapping override.
vectors.input: SlideLayout XML of type 'title' with matchingName 'Title Slide'.

vectors.name: Slide Shapes & Placeholders
vectors.description: Validates slide cSld shape tree, non-visual properties, placeholder (type='title', idx=0), and text body.
vectors.input: Slide XML with a title placeholder shape containing text 'Quarterly Results'.

vectors.name: Theme Color Scheme & Font Scheme
vectors.description: Validates theme color scheme (12 theme colors) and font scheme (major and minor Latin fonts).
vectors.input: Theme XML with Office theme colors and Aptos Display / Aptos fonts.

vectors.name: Placeholder Matching by Index (idx)
vectors.description: Resolves slide placeholder to layout placeholder matching explicit index attribute.
vectors.input: Slide shape with ph idx=1 matching layout shape with idx=1.

vectors.name: Placeholder Matching by Type
vectors.description: Resolves slide placeholder to layout placeholder by ph_type='title' when idx is omitted.
vectors.input: Slide shape with ph type='title' matching layout shape with type='title'.

vectors.name: Placeholder Fallback: ctrTitle -> title
vectors.description: Applies ECMA-376 fallback rule: centered title placeholder matches master title placeholder.
vectors.input: Slide shape with ph type='ctrTitle' matched against master with type='title'.

vectors.name: Placeholder Fallback: subTitle -> body
vectors.description: Applies ECMA-376 fallback rule: subtitle placeholder matches master body placeholder.
vectors.input: Slide shape with ph type='subTitle' matched against master with type='body'.

vectors.name: Transform2D Coordinate Inheritance
vectors.description: Inherits 2D affine transform (x, y, cx, cy in EMUs) through layout from master when unspecified on slide.
vectors.input: Slide shape without xfrm inheriting from master shape with x=1234, y=5678, cx=91011, cy=121314.

vectors.name: Preset Geometry Inheritance
vectors.description: Inherits shape geometry (preset 'roundRect') through layout from master.
vectors.input: Slide shape without geometry inheriting from master geometry 'roundRect'.

vectors.name: Fill and Outline Stroke Inheritance
vectors.description: Inherits solid fill and line properties through layout from master.
vectors.input: Master shape with solid fill #156082 and 2pt dashed outline.

vectors.name: Text Styling: Master titleStyle
vectors.description: Title placeholder inherits master titleStyle lvl1 formatting: 44pt font size, bold, centered.
vectors.input: Slide title placeholder without direct formatting inheriting from master titleStyle.

vectors.name: Text Styling: Master bodyStyle Multi-Level
vectors.description: Body placeholder inherits multi-level list formatting (levels 0, 1, 2) with decreasing font sizes and margins.
vectors.input: Slide body placeholder with 3 paragraphs at levels 0, 1, and 2.

vectors.name: Text Styling: Master otherStyle for Text Boxes
vectors.description: Non-placeholder text box inherits master otherStyle default formatting.
vectors.input: Arbitrary text box on slide inheriting 16pt from master otherStyle.

vectors.name: Text Styling: Presentation defaultTextStyle Fallback
vectors.description: Falls back to presentation defaultTextStyle (22pt) when master styles do not specify run size.
vectors.input: Slide text box falling back to presentation-level defaultTextStyle.

vectors.name: Direct Text Formatting Override
vectors.description: Direct formatting on slide run and paragraph overrides master cascade completely.
vectors.input: Slide run with explicit sz=5000 (50pt), bold=true, italic=true, align='r'.

vectors.name: Theme Color Mapping via p:clrMap
vectors.description: Maps scheme color token 'tx1' -> 'dk1' -> #000000 via master p:clrMap.
vectors.input: ColorChoice::Scheme('tx1') with master color map bg1=lt1, tx1=dk1.

vectors.name: Color Map Override via p:clrMapOvr
vectors.description: Layout color map override re-maps 'tx1' to 'accent1' (#156082).
vectors.input: SlideLayout with overrideClrMapping tx1='accent1'.

vectors.name: Color Transform: Tint
vectors.description: Applies linear tint towards white: (1 - t) * C + t * 255.

vectors.name: Color Transform: Shade
vectors.description: Applies linear shade towards black: s * C.
vectors.input: Base RGB [200, 200, 200] with 50% shade (50000).

vectors.name: Color Transform: Luminance Modulation
vectors.description: Applies HSL luminance scaling by factor lumMod / 100000.
vectors.input: Base RGB [128, 128, 128] with lumMod 80000.

vectors.name: Color Transform: Alpha Opacity
vectors.description: Scales alpha channel from 0..100000 to byte 0..255.
vectors.input: Base RGB [255, 0, 0] with alpha 50000 (50%).

vectors.name: Theme Font Scheme Major Latin (+mj-lt)
vectors.description: Resolves +mj-lt to Theme majorFont.latin ('Aptos Display').
vectors.input: +mj-lt typeface reference.

vectors.name: Theme Font Scheme Minor Latin (+mn-lt)
vectors.description: Resolves +mn-lt to Theme minorFont.latin ('Aptos').
vectors.input: +mn-lt typeface reference.

vectors.name: Baseline PPTX Package Open & Structure
vectors.description: Opens baseline.pptx verifying 2 slides, slide master, slide layouts, and theme.
vectors.input: specs/evidence/ppt/baseline.pptx

vectors.name: Baseline PPTX 3-Tier Slide Resolution
vectors.description: Resolves all shapes on slides in baseline.pptx extracting run text, font families, and sizes.
vectors.input: Slide 0 in baseline.pptx with text 'OpenOfficeRS Unified Engine'.

vectors.name: Baseline PPTX Lossless Round-Trip
vectors.description: Opens baseline.pptx, saves to byte stream, re-opens, and asserts full equality.
vectors.input: baseline.pptx save and re-load cycle.

vectors.name: Test Vectors Manifest Validation
vectors.description: Validates that specs/evidence/ppt/4.1.1_vectors.json exists, is valid JSON, and has >= 25 vectors.
vectors.input: specs/evidence/ppt/4.1.1_vectors.json
